issuer: the Wisconsin Department of Transportation, Division of Motor Vehicles (DMV)
note: WisDOT's DMV fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives an original regular Class D licence (8 year) at $42.50, an original probationary licence (expiring 2 years from the next birthday) at $28, and an original 8-year ID card at $28 (free for voting). The graduated licence FAQ says the graduated licence keeps novice drivers aged 15 to 18 from high-risk driving, so a full licence is kept from 18 (a new driver of any age is first on a probationary licence, not held). No youngest age for the card was read.
